correctness.rationale: Exact conditioning on a selected collision pair gives \(\operatorname{Cov}(K_n,\widehat G_n)=2s_2A_n-(1+s_2)B_n\). Under the size-biased category law, \(B_n/A_n\le s_2\) because the factor \((1-P)^{n-2}\) is antitone in \(P\). This yields the strict positive lower bound and the stated equality cases.

value.rationale: Richness and Gini--Simpson diversity are canonical complementary summaries of categorical diversity. The theorem supplies an exact finite-sample joint relationship valid under arbitrary category heterogeneity, with a strict universal sign and sharp equality structure. This is a motivated structural fact useful for interpreting joint fluctuations of two commonly reported diversity summaries.
